title: Assess shared helpers needed by rescue ISO
description: Completed 2026-10-05: published impermanence helper in commit 6a0d3de (`origin/main`). nix-config flake.lock now pins that published commit, verified by lock metadata. Focused nix-lib check passed; all three miniserver system closures and four QEMU Disko layout checks (three miniserver plus Nanoserver, including two-cycle/double-destroy coverage) pass against the published pin with no local path override. The helper exposes existing impermanence mkPersistDir/mkPersistFile APIs through builder specialArgs. No unrelated source files were included in the source commit.
